displayName: Virtual machines should have backup enabled
description: Ensure Azure virtual machines are protected with Azure Backup. The backup must be associated with an active Recovery Services Vault and a backup policy.
evaluationLogic: COMPLIANT when: resource.type === 'VirtualMachine' AND linkedResources.some(r => r.type === 'RecoveryServicesVault') AND linkedResources.some(r => r.type === 'BackupProtectedItem')
